name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached directly in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, eaten from the pan.

tcm.note: Tomato and pepper cooked down, with egg.

ayurveda.note: Anda is ushna and the sauce is chilli-spiced.

histamine.note: Tomato reduced down plus egg — one of the highest breakfasts there is, for something that looks so plain.
